info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "bfl/flux-2-pro", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.
